name: hub-publishing-contract
description: The research hub's publishing contract: the manifest JSON Schema, its fixtures, the dependency-free validator used by contract/publish/action.yml, and the check that proves the schema accepts the example and rejects every invalid fixture. ajv is a devDependency only - it cross-checks the validator in the test suite and is never needed at publish time. Pinned exactly and locked by package-lock.json; bump through a reviewed lockfile change.
